topic: how to open a high yield savings account chase
slug: how to open a high yield savings account chase

steps.narration: Know this first: Chase doesn't market a personal account under the name "high yield savings". Its savings options are Chase Savings and Premier Savings; rates run below online-only banks, so check the current rates page before you open one.
Open chase.com and hover over "Savings & CDs".
Open the Chase Savings page and click "Open an account".
Sign in or continue as a new customer, and fill in the application (identity, address, funding source).
Skip the monthly service fee by opening with $0 when you set up an automatic savings plan, or meet a balance requirement.
Turn on Autosave in the app: round-ups on debit purchases and a recurring transfer.
Fund the account from checking or an outside bank, and you're set.
